baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural sea noun is followed by an intensive passive rupture verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Abundant water held in multiple basin-like grounds is forced through wide openings; containment failure is distributed rather than a single local wave.

activation_trace.role: Supplies broad abundant water as the material released by the event.
Supplies water-gathering ground as the normally holding container that fails.
Supplies wide splitting, outflow, and opened channels as the rupture process.

changed_reading.after: Multiple water-holding systems are breached and their contents are driven into new cross-basin channels.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object can itself carry a cleft image while its predicate performs another wide splitting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sea is read as an existing broad cut in terrain that is cut open again. The event changes the topology of coast, bed, and channel, not merely the agitation of water inside them.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the sea as an already existing broad cleft in the terrain.
Supplies a second wide split that reopens and extends the first cut.

changed_reading.before: Water bursts out of intact geographical containers.
changed_reading.after: The geographical cuts called seas are themselves re-cut, erasing the distinction between basin, barrier, and outlet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sea root can activate open exposure, while the rupture root can activate dawn breaking out of night.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rupture changes a deep, visually closed domain into an exposed one. The event can therefore be carried as an unveiling with a dawnlike transition, alongside the literal hydraulic event.

activation_trace.role: Supplies unscreened open exposure as the resulting state of the sea domain.
Supplies light breaking from darkness as the temporal image of disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a destructive marine event.
changed_reading.after: The marine rupture also marks a transition from screened depth to open, dawnlike visibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A water-holding domain is paired with a branch of the predicate that breaches restraint and departs from a right course.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seas normally occupy bounded courses; being made to burst is a physical overstepping of those limits. This is a structural transgression model before any moral context is consulted.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the low ground that gathers water and gives the water a bounded place.
Supplies departure from a right course through a breach of restraint.

changed_reading.after: Bounded waters are made to overstep their appointed courses, so physical rupture already carries the shape of violated restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sky can be carried both as an overhead canopy and, through the packet's non-dominant split mapping, as a narrow aperture; its opening above aligns with basins split below. The focus becomes the lower station in a vertical failure of boundaries.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the lower water-holding ground in the proposed vertical system.
Supplies the opening of lower channels through which held water can pass.
Supplies an overhead covering domain as the upper boundary of the system.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies a penetrable aperture, sharpening the perforation image without replacing the sky sense.
Supplies opening and splitting at the upper boundary, parallel to the focus rupture below.

structural_cues: 82:1 precedes the focus within repeated conditional clauses, and both large domains undergo opening before an agent is named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies canopy, split-mapping aperture, upper opening, basin, and lower outflow; I infer one vertical top-and-bottom system from their sequence. They may instead be independent parallel ruptures.

changed_reading.before: The seas rupture laterally within terrestrial geography.
changed_reading.after: Upper and lower boundaries are perforated in sequence, making the sea burst part of a vertical circulation or collapse across the whole world-frame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding branches combine nocturnal droplets with the casting of separate units. Applied to the focus's abundant water and sudden collective burst, this opens a dispersive reading that competes with simple basin-merger.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the continuous marine mass that can be broken into dispersed units.
Supplies many things arriving in a sudden burst, converting release into multiple fronts.
Supplies a droplet-scale nocturnal image that makes granulation of the marine mass imaginable.
Supplies casting into separated pieces as the distributive motion imposed on those units.

structural_cues: 82:2 immediately precedes 82:3 and repeats the pattern of a plural cosmic subject undergoing sudden transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies droplets, scattering, abundant water, and sudden multiplicity; I transfer the preceding material pattern to the seas. The live alternative is that stars alone scatter while the seas merge into one flood.

changed_reading.before: Breached basins pour together into a larger continuous flood.
changed_reading.after: At least one live reading disperses marine mass into innumerable cast droplets, jets, or separate fronts rather than only merging it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah moves from a low concealed place to overturned ground that reveals what it held. That container-content reversal strengthens the focus as an opening of marine depth and disclosure of submerged contents, not only displacement of water.

activation_trace.role: Supplies unscreened exposure as the new state of formerly hidden marine depth.
Supplies a low water-gathering container whose inside can be turned outward.
Supplies the opening that gives the held contents an exit and visibility.
Supplies low concealment as the neighboring model of a closed depth.
Supplies overturned soil and revelation of what was buried as the neighboring reversal.

structural_cues: 82:4 follows immediately in the same conditional series and shifts from ruptured waters to overturned graves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two containers, concealment, opening, and revelation of contents; I infer that the grave's explicit inside-out reversal clarifies the sea event. The alternative is a merely parallel resurrection scene with no transfer to marine depth.

changed_reading.after: The basin's depth is turned outward: waters and the submerged inventory they screened are jointly exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dawnlike exposure after depth rupture is followed first by knowing and later by guarding and inscription. The physical opening becomes a forensic threshold at which what was held and recorded can no longer remain screened.

activation_trace.role: Supplies open exposure as the focus event's evidentiary state.
Supplies emergence from darkness as the focus event's disclosure transition.
Supplies the immediate result: something becomes uncovered to a knower.
Supplies active guarding of material that remains available for later disclosure.
Supplies an inscription that fixes consequence or judgment, giving the disclosed material forensic force.

structural_cues: 82:5 makes knowing the immediate outcome of the four upheavals; 82:10-12 later names guardians, writers, and knowledge of acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, emergence from darkness, knowledge, custody, and consequential inscription; I infer a forensic chain and treat the sea opening as its first material enactment. The alternative is that only human deeds, not the sea event, form the record.

changed_reading.before: The rupture makes hidden geography visible.
changed_reading.after: The rupture initiates a forensic disclosure: screened contents and preserved consequences become knowable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later compositional sequence supplies measure, counterbalance, and layering. Read back into the water-holding basin and its opened channels, the focus becomes de-composition of a calibrated hydraulic architecture rather than random chaos.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a water-holding component whose placement belongs to the larger arrangement.
Supplies the split and new channels that undo the component's former relation to the whole.
Supplies prior estimation and measure as the design condition being reversed.
Supplies counterbalanced loads as a concrete image for stable hydraulic equilibrium.
Supplies layer upon layer as the mode by which the ordered whole had been assembled.

structural_cues: 82:7-8 accumulates creation, straightening, balancing, forming, and composing after the opening upheavals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured, balanced, layered human composition; I infer that sea basins likewise function as composed parts and read their rupture as systematic de-composition. The alternative confines the compositional language to the human body.

changed_reading.before: An overwhelming accident destroys marine stability.
changed_reading.after: A measured arrangement is taken apart at its hydraulic joints: basin, barrier, and channel cease to perform their calibrated roles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus rupture and the later moral class share the same root, making the restraint-breach branch recur inside the surah. The seas' overstepping can therefore exteriorize in matter the disorder named in moral agents without replacing the literal sea event.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a bounded water-place whose limits can be physically violated.
Supplies breached restraint as a live but initially secondary force in the focus predicate.
The later same-root moral noun reactivates breached restraint and makes the physical-moral echo structurally visible.

structural_cues: The focus root recurs in 82:14 within the opposed outcomes of the righteous and the morally unrestrained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root recurrence and one branch spanning physical and moral breach; I infer an analogical exteriorization from agent to cosmos. The alternative is polysemy with no intended cross-domain arrow.

changed_reading.before: The seas simply fail to remain within their physical limits.
changed_reading.after: The world's bounded waters enact outwardly the breach of restraint later named in the moral class, tying cosmic and moral disorder while preserving both senses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches place intense fire beside the process of heating and altering something with fire. Their proximity to the earlier released water permits a material reading in which rupture exposes the seas to a thermal regime, not only to lateral flooding.

activation_trace.role: Supplies abundant water as the material potentially subjected to thermal change.
Supplies the openings that expose and redistribute that material.
Supplies the later domain of fiercely intensified fire and heat.
Supplies heating and alteration by fire as a possible process acting on the released water.

structural_cues: The surah moves from ruptured seas to the fiery destination and entry into it, but never explicitly states an interaction between those materials.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies released water, fierce heat, and fire-driven alteration; I infer a possible interaction and phase change across the sequence. The materially live alternative is that the water upheaval and moral fire remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The released seas remain water and produce inundation.
changed_reading.after: One exploratory material reading places the exposed waters under transformative heat, allowing vaporization or another phase change alongside the flood reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's water-holding ground loses its capacity to contain, while the final ayah removes local disposition and locates authority beyond every secondary holder. Physical de-containment becomes an analogue for the end of local control.

activation_trace.role: Supplies local ground whose defining function is to gather and hold water.
Supplies the breach through which that local holding function ends.
Supplies cohesion and self-holding as the capacity withdrawn from local systems.
Supplies possession and power of disposition as the personal analogue of basin containment.
Supplies final authority as the contrasting concentration after secondary control disappears.

structural_cues: 82:19 closes the sequence by denying one soul power for another and locating the affair's authority with God; the focus predicate is passive and names no local agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed physical holder, loss of personal disposition, and final authority; I infer that containment and delegated control are parallel kinds of local holding. The alternative limits the final statement to moral agency alone.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts failure of marine geography.
changed_reading.after: The failure is also de-sovereigning: basins cannot hold water just as secondary selves cannot hold disposition, so localized control collapses at both scales.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns two moral labels into a land-water topology through remote branch images. It remains anchored by the focus's sea and breach roots plus the adjacent opposed classes, but downstream prose must present it as a symbolic branch echo, never as the lexical translation of either class.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs marine expanse with breached restraint, allowing the later opposed moral classes to spatialize that contrast.

activation_trace.role: Supplies expansive water as one pole of the proposed moral landscape.
Supplies breached restraint as the unstable motion of the water pole.
Supplies dry land as the contrasting stable ground activated under the righteous class.
Supplies the same restraint-breach branch under the opposed moral class, completing the cross-domain polarity.

changed_reading.before: The later moral opposition is unrelated to the earlier sea rupture.
changed_reading.after: A contained symbolic reading casts righteousness as stable dry ground and moral breach as unbounded overflow, making the sea rupture a moral topography.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's dominant split mapping for the later knowledge verb, yielding gushing and whirlpool images that are form-distant from ordinary cognition. It remains valid as an activation tied back to the focus's water and outflow, but downstream prose must call it a split-map resonance rather than an etymology or direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus couples abundant water with forced outflow, providing a concrete mechanism for the later repeated challenge to knowing.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the engulfing abundance used to model cognition as a material event.
Supplies forced issue from opened channels as the shape of arriving knowledge.
The split mapping supplies abundant issue from a source, turning the first repeated knowing-question into a cognitive outflow trigger.
The split mapping supplies a water vortex, making the second repetition engulfing and destabilizing rather than calmly informative.

changed_reading.before: The repeated knowing-questions only emphasize that the judgment day exceeds ordinary comprehension.
changed_reading.after: Knowing arrives like the burst sea: disclosure gushes from its source and draws the mind into a repeated cognitive vortex.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus sea root's medical-crisis branch is explicitly later technical vocabulary, and the life-blood link is cross-domain. It remains packet-anchored as a retrospective material analogy for systemic transition, but downstream prose must mark it as post-Qur'anic activation and never offer it as the noun's historical lexical sense here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A later technical branch under the focus sea root combines with sudden collective bursting and a neighboring life-blood cue to model systemic crisis.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a retrospective acute-crisis turning point, functioning only as an analogical model of system change.
Supplies depth and intense bloodlike redness, linking the waters cautiously to a bodily interior.
Supplies sudden collective onset as the crisis event rather than gradual decline.
Supplies flowing blood as support of life, completing the cautiously carried circulatory analogy.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos suffers an external hydrological failure.
changed_reading.after: Retrospectively and analogically, the plural seas behave like a cosmic circulation crossing a sudden acute crisis point.

strongest_changes: Adjacent sky-opening and stellar-scattering cues split the hydraulic baseline into vertical perforation and dispersal readings that coexist with basin merger.
The graves-to-knowledge-to-record sequence turns marine rupture into exposure of hidden contents and forensic consequence.
The exact later recurrence of the focus rupture root under the morally unrestrained class strongly activates a physical-moral breach echo.
The final loss of personal disposition reframes failed basin containment as the end of localized holding and control.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained hydraulic, topological, revelatory, moral, thermal, and sovereignty readings without forcing a choice. Non-dominant and split mappings added a contained vertical aperture and cognitive deluge, while an explicitly later technical branch preserved a retrospective cosmic-crisis outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The stellar scattering pattern may remain confined to the stars rather than transfer materially to marine water.
The fire sequence may describe a separate moral destination rather than thermal transformation of the released seas.
The dry-land moral topology, cognitive vortex, and medical crisis are branch activations, not lexical glosses, and require explicit qualification.
The focus passive leaves its agent unstated; the final authority statement supports but does not grammatically prove the proposed de-sovereigning relation.
